videos.title: Real robot and simulation teleoperation
videos.what_it_proves: A recorded operator-controlled teleoperation session links the physical dual-arm setup and Isaac simulation. This is a system demonstration, not an autonomous policy success-rate test.
videos.origin: existing site video, browser-compatible H.264 transcode

videos.title: Matched basket diagnostic: ACT success, TC-ACT failure
videos.what_it_proves: One matched-reset example from 21 October 2026. Both policies start at identical cube XY coordinates; ACT succeeds and TC-ACT fails. A single example does not estimate success rates.
videos.origin: new presentation of two complete existing diagnostic recordings
videos.editing: Original 10 fps and full recorded trajectories preserved. Labels and side-by-side layout added. ACT completes at 8.5 s; its final frame is held until the TC clip ends at 14.2 s. No failure removed.
videos.results_note: This ±4 cm diagnostic is separate from the later five-seed main evaluation.

videos.title: Hardware cup mapping test
videos.what_it_proves: An existing recorded physical robot mapping test with a cup and cubes. The recording alone does not identify the policy checkpoint or establish repeated success.
videos.origin: existing site video, browser-compatible H.264 transcode
